# Projection

`<fixtures>/ungrounded.tsare`

Quoted text is a field, copied verbatim: a paraphrase of a claim is a new claim.
The indented note under each quote is the projection's own -- what the sentence
stands on, who checks it, and what is still owed.

### F_SCROLL -- fact

> the list scrolls at 60 fps

  evidence: tool("trace") | obligation: check (ready)

### F_HEADLESS -- fact

> no rendering happens with --headless

  evidence: tool("run --headless") | obligation: check (ready)

### C_RENDERED -- concept

> the list is rendered

  grounded_by: F_SCROLL | against: F_HEADLESS | obligation: induce (blocked), no clause found; see OPEN.md

### P_THRESHOLD -- proposition

> users cannot tell 60 fps from 120 fps

  uses: C_RENDERED | obligation: prove (assumed), no premises; treated as an assumption
  ! W-BARE-NUMBER: P_THRESHOLD states a number and cites no measured value: nothing here says what produced it

### P_SMOOTH -- proposition

> scrolling feels smooth to users

  from: P_THRESHOLD | obligation: prove (ready)
  ! W-CONDITIONAL: P_SMOOTH is supported only through an ungrounded premise: W_RENDER needs P_THRESHOLD (asserted)

### W_RENDER -- warrant

> an imperceptible difference is not a smoothness problem

  from: P_THRESHOLD | to: P_SMOOTH | basis: C_RENDERED | obligation: justify (ready)
